proposal.summary: Prior to version 1.18.7, DataEase contains a deserialization vulnerability in the datasource that can be exploited to execute arbitrary code. The issue is fixed in v1.18.7; no workarounds are known other than upgrading.
proposal.cwe_quote: a deserialization vulnerability exists in the DataEase datasource, which can be exploited to execute arbitrary code.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Advise users to upgrade DataEase to v1.18.7; if immediate upgrade is not possible, identify and restrict access to the affected datasource component until patched.
